oneLiner: 单位时间内浓度的变化，衡量反应快慢。
oneLinerEn: Change of concentration per unit time; measures speed.
detail: 速率的定义是 v = Δc/Δt，单位取 mol/(L·s) 或 mol/(L·min)；它是标量、只取正值，而且必须写明是用哪种物质表示的，因为同一反应用不同物质算出的数值不同，其比恰好等于化学计量数之比：合成氨里 v(H₂):v(N₂):v(NH₃) = 3:1:2。比较两个条件下的快慢时必须先换算成同一种物质，或各自除以计量数之后再比，否则会出现假结论——v(H₂) = 0.3 与 v(NH₃) = 0.2 看着不相等，换算成 N₂ 却都是 0.1，两条件其实一样快。中学阶段算的是某段时间内的平均速率，不是瞬时速率。两条禁用要记牢：固体（CaCO₃、锌粒）与纯液体的浓度视为常数，不能用它们的 Δc 表示速率，但固体的表面积确实影响速率，这两件事不要混。所有计算都靠三段式：起始量、转化量、某时刻量三行，其中转化量之比等于计量数之比，浓度则一律除以容器体积统一到 mol/L。加水稀释改变的是浓度而不是物质的量；恒温恒容下充入不参与反应的气体（如 He），总压升高而各组分浓度不变，速率不变；恒温恒压下充入惰性气体，体积膨胀使浓度下降、速率减慢——恒容与恒压这两种容器情形的分别是速率题里最集中的陷阱。最后，速率与转化率是两件事：速率讲快慢、转化率讲多少，催化剂能加快前者而完全不改变后者。
detailEn: Reaction rate is the change of concentration per unit time, v = Δc/Δt, quoted in mol per litre per second or per minute. It is a positive scalar and it always has to name the substance used, since the same reaction gives different numbers for different species in the ratio of their coefficients: in ammonia synthesis v(H₂) : v(N₂) : v(NH₃) = 3 : 1 : 2. Comparing two sets of conditions therefore requires converting both to the same substance first, or dividing each by its own coefficient, otherwise 0.3 for hydrogen and 0.2 for ammonia look unequal while both correspond to 0.1 for nitrogen and the two rates are in fact identical. School problems use average rates over an interval, never instantaneous ones. Two species may not be used: solids such as calcium carbonate or zinc granules, and pure liquids, whose concentration is a constant, so their Δc says nothing — although the surface area of a solid most certainly does change the rate, and the two points must not be confused. Every calculation rests on the three-row bookkeeping of initial amount, change and remaining amount, where the changes are forced into the ratio of the coefficients and concentrations are obtained by dividing by the volume of the container. Dilution alters concentration without altering the amount of substance; an inert gas admitted at constant volume raises the total pressure and leaves every concentration untouched, so the rate does not budge, whereas the same addition at constant pressure inflates the volume, lowers all concentrations and slows the reaction down. Telling the two vessels apart is the sharpest trap in the topic. Rate and conversion are finally not the same question: rate asks how fast, conversion asks how far, and a catalyst accelerates the first while leaving the second exactly where it was.

oneLiner: 浓度、压强、温度、催化剂都能改变反应速率。
oneLinerEn: Concentration, pressure, temperature and catalysts all change rate.
detail: 内因是反应物本身的性质，它起决定作用：钠与冷水剧烈反应而铁必须靠水蒸气，同浓度盐酸里镁比铁快得多。外因五条，机理分两类。浓度：增大反应物浓度使单位体积内活化分子数目增多、有效碰撞次数上升，速率加快，但活化分子百分数不变。压强：只有涉及气体才有意义，本质是改变浓度——压缩体积使浓度增大而速率加快；恒温恒容下充入不参与反应的气体，总压升高而各组分浓度不变，速率不变；恒温恒压下充入惰性气体则体积增大、浓度减小、速率减慢，两种容器必须分清。温度：升温使更多分子获得足够能量变成活化分子，活化分子百分数显著增大，所以温度对速率的影响远大于浓度，经验上每升高 10 ℃ 速率增到 2–4 倍。催化剂：降低反应所需活化能 Eₐ，使活化分子百分数剧增，并同等程度地加快正、逆两个方向的速率，因此它既不改 ΔH 也不改平衡位置，只缩短达到平衡所需的时间。其他因素有固体表面积（锌粉比锌粒快得多）、光照（HClO、AgNO₃ 见光分解，H₂ 与 Cl₂ 混合光照即爆炸）、溶剂与超声。最要紧的区分只有一句话：只有温度和催化剂能提高活化分子百分数，浓度与压强只增加单位体积内活化分子数而百分数不变，选择题专门在这里设坑。催化剂另有三性：选择性（同一催化剂对不同反应效果不同，酶更有专一性且怕高温）、中毒（铂与铁触媒遇含硫、磷或铅的杂质失活，因此汽车要烧无铅汽油并装三元催化）、以及参与反应而最终不变——反应前后质量与化学性质不变，物理状态可能改变，所以不能说催化剂不参加反应。
detailEn: The decisive factor is inside the reactants themselves: sodium rips through cold water while iron needs steam, and magnesium outruns iron in the same hydrochloric acid. Five external factors then work through two different mechanisms. Raising a concentration packs more activated molecules into each unit volume, so effective collisions multiply and the rate climbs, yet the fraction of activated molecules stays the same. Pressure matters only when gases are involved and is really a concentration change: squeezing the vessel speeds things up, while admitting helium at constant volume raises the total pressure and changes nothing at all, and admitting it at constant pressure stretches the volume and slows the reaction down. Temperature acts on the fraction itself, driving more molecules over the energy barrier, which is why its effect dwarfs every other lever — roughly a two- to four-fold increase per 10 ℃ by the old rule of thumb. A catalyst lowers the barrier and lifts that fraction sharply, accelerating the forward and reverse directions by the same factor, so it never changes ΔH, never moves the equilibrium position, and only shortens the wait for it. Surface area, light, solvent and ultrasound make up the rest: zinc dust beats a granule, and hypochlorous acid or silver nitrate decompose in the light. The one distinction worth memorising is that only temperature and a catalyst change the percentage of activated molecules, whereas concentration and pressure change only how many sit in each unit volume. Catalysts carry three further properties: selectivity, since one catalyst suits one reaction and enzymes are pickier still and denature in heat; poisoning, since sulfur, phosphorus or lead residues kill platinum and the iron contact, which is why cars need unleaded fuel and a three-way converter; and finally the fact that a catalyst does take part in the reaction and is merely regenerated at the end, so its mass and chemical properties are unchanged while its physical form may not be.

oneLiner: 正逆反应速率相等、各组分浓度保持不变的可逆状态。
oneLinerEn: Forward and reverse rates equal; concentrations stay constant in a reversible reaction.
detail: 可逆反应在同一条件下正、逆两个方向同时进行，因此反应物不可能全部转化，产率永远小于 100%。平衡的本质是 v正 = v逆，宏观表现是各组分浓度与百分含量保持不变；它是动态平衡——微观上分子仍在不停反应，只是生成与消耗相抵。判断是否已达到平衡分两类题。速率类必须同时满足一正一逆且换算后相等：对 N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃，v正(H₂) = 3v逆(N₂) 是平衡，而 v正(H₂) = v逆(NH₃) 不平衡；两个都描述正方向的速率无论数值如何匹配都不能作判据。变量类要看原本会变的量现在不再变：恒温恒容的密闭容器里，总压强、气体总物质的量、平均摩尔质量、有色气体（如 NO₂ 的红棕色）的颜色都随反应进行而变化过，它们一旦不再变化就是平衡标志；反之，反应前后气体分子数相等的反应（H₂ + I₂(g) ⇌ 2HI）压强从头到尾不变，不能作标志；全部是气体且容器体积固定时密度始终不变，同样不能作标志。平衡常数 K 只随温度变化，K 越大说明正反应进行的程度越大。还要分开速率变化与平衡移动这两件事：加催化剂速率变了而平衡不移；改变压强对分子数相等的反应也不移。工业合成氨选 400–500 ℃、20–50 MPa 与铁触媒，正是速率与平衡互相妥协的结果：温度低对平衡有利但速率太慢，压强高既有利又推高设备与安全成本。
detailEn: A reversible reaction runs both ways under the same conditions, so no reactant can ever be converted completely and the yield stays below one hundred percent. Equilibrium means the forward and reverse rates have become equal, and its macroscopic sign is that every concentration and percentage stops changing; it is dynamic, since molecules are still reacting in both directions at full speed, merely cancelling each other out. Judging whether equilibrium has been reached splits into two question types. Rate statements must show one forward and one reverse rate and must agree after conversion: for N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ the equality v_forward(H₂) = 3 v_reverse(N₂) does signal equilibrium while v_forward(H₂) = v_reverse(NH₃) does not, and two statements that both describe the forward direction prove nothing however neatly they match. Constant statements must ask which quantities were still changing: in a rigid sealed vessel at fixed temperature, total pressure, total moles of gas, average molar mass and the colour of a gas such as reddish-brown NO₂ all move during the reaction, so each of them freezing is a genuine sign; but a reaction whose gas molecules balance on both sides, H₂ + I₂ ⇌ 2HI, never changes its pressure and cannot serve, and with every species gaseous in a fixed volume the density is constant from start to finish and is likewise worthless. The equilibrium constant K answers to temperature alone, and a larger K means the reaction has gone further toward products. Changing a rate is not the same as shifting an equilibrium: a catalyst speeds both directions and shifts nothing, and pressure changes leave a balanced reaction where it was. Industrial ammonia is run at 400–500 ℃ over an iron contact at 20–50 MPa precisely because rate and equilibrium pull in opposite directions — cold would favour the yield but is far too slow, and extra pressure helps but costs equipment and safety margin.

subs.name: 氮气
subs.note: 合成氨原料，来自空气分离。

subs.name: 铁触媒
subs.note: 加快达到平衡，不改平衡位置。
subs.noteEn: Speeds arrival at equilibrium without shifting it.

oneLiner: 改变影响平衡的条件，平衡向减弱这种改变的方向移动。
oneLinerEn: When a stress is applied, equilibrium shifts to counteract it.
detail: 内容是：如果改变影响平衡的一个条件（浓度、温度、压强），平衡就向能够减弱这种改变的方向移动。关键字是减弱而不是消除：对 N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ 的平衡体系恒温恒容再充入 N₂，平衡正向移动，但新平衡时 N₂ 的浓度仍然比原平衡大，只是比刚充入完的那一瞬间小；升温使平衡向吸热方向移动，却并不能把温度降回原值——这一条最反直觉，也是判断题的主要落点。四条用法要连着限制条件一起记。浓度：增大反应物浓度平衡正移，该反应物自身的转化率反而降低，而另一种反应物的转化率升高，这就是工业上让廉价原料过量以提高贵重原料转化率的依据。压强：只对涉及气体且反应前后气体分子数不等的反应有意义，压缩体积增大压强使平衡向分子数少的一侧移动；若分子数相等（H₂ + I₂ ⇌ 2HI），改变压强不移动。温度：升温向吸热方向、降温向放热方向，且只有温度的改变才会改变平衡常数 K，因此凡是让 K 不变的操作都不可能是温度变化。催化剂完全不移动平衡；恒容时充入惰性气体各组分浓度没变，平衡不移动，而恒压时充入惰性气体相当于减压，平衡向分子数多的一侧移动。适用边界同样要讲清：原理只适用于已经达到平衡的体系，不能用来判断反应速率，也不能回答是否平衡；它的定量版本更可靠——比较浓度商 Q 与 K，Q 小于 K 正向进行、相等即平衡、大于 K 逆向进行，遇到几个条件同时改变的复杂情形就按 Q 与 K 判方向而不是背口诀。工业上把生成的 NH₃ 及时液化分离，就是用不断移走产物让平衡一路右移的办法。
detailEn: Le Chatelier's principle says that if one of the conditions controlling an equilibrium — concentration, temperature or pressure — is altered, the system shifts in the direction that weakens the change. The operative word is weaken, not undo: injecting extra nitrogen into a balanced N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ mixture at constant volume does shift it right, yet the new equilibrium still holds more nitrogen than the old one, less only than the instant after injection; heating drives a system toward the endothermic direction without ever pulling the temperature back down. This single subtlety is where most exam judgements are lost. Each lever carries its own condition. Raising a reactant concentration shifts the reaction forward but lowers that reactant's own percentage conversion while raising the other's, which is exactly why industry floods the expensive feedstock with a cheap excess. Pressure counts only for gas reactions whose molecule numbers differ across the equation; compressing shifts toward fewer molecules, and a balanced equation such as H₂ + I₂ ⇌ 2HI ignores pressure entirely. Temperature is the only lever that changes K itself, so any argument concluding that K has changed must be about temperature. A catalyst never shifts an equilibrium; an inert gas added at constant volume changes no concentration and moves nothing, while the same addition at constant pressure swells the volume and acts as a decompression, favouring the side with more molecules. The principle applies only to a system already at equilibrium, and it says nothing about how fast a reaction goes nor settles whether one has been reached; its quantitative replacement is more trustworthy, comparing the reaction quotient Q with K — below K the reaction runs forward, equal means balanced, above K it runs backward — which is how to treat cases where several conditions change at once instead of reciting a slogan. Industry liquefies and removes the ammonia as it forms, so continuous withdrawal keeps dragging the equilibrium to the right.

oneLiner: 弱酸弱碱部分电离，存在电离平衡，用电离度与 Ka 描述。
oneLinerEn: Weak acids/bases partially ionize; described by degree of ionization and Ka.
detail: 强弱电解质的分界只看是否完全电离，与溶解度和导电能力都无关：BaSO₄、AgCl 难溶，但溶进去的那一点完全电离，所以是强电解质；醋酸与水任意比混溶却是弱电解质——易溶就是强、难溶就是弱是错的。导电能力取决于离子浓度与离子所带电荷，极稀的强酸溶液可能比浓醋酸导电还弱。电离平衡同样是逆、等、动、定、变的动态平衡，且电离吸热，所以升温促进电离。三条影响方向要分清：加水稀释促进电离，电离度增大，但溶液里 c(H⁺) 仍然下降、pH 升高，因为体积涨得比新电离出的离子快；加入含相同离子的物质（醋酸里加醋酸钠或加盐酸）抑制电离，平衡左移；升温促进电离，Ka、Kw 都随之增大。Ka 只与温度有关，同一温度下 Ka 越大酸性越强。多元弱酸分步电离且第一步远大于第二步（H₂CO₃ 的 Ka1 约 4.4×10⁻⁷、Ka2 约 4.7×10⁻¹¹），所以 NaHCO₃ 溶液里 HCO₃⁻ 既能电离又能水解，最终以水解为主而显碱性。判断某酸是弱酸的三种实验办法最实用：同浓度同元酸比 pH，醋酸明显大于盐酸；同浓度同体积与足量锌反应，最终产氢量相同而醋酸开始慢、后期仍在产气（说明储备的分子还在不断电离补充）；把 pH 相同的两种酸各稀释 10 倍，盐酸 pH 正好升 1 个单位而醋酸升高不足 1。水的电离也归在这里：纯水在 25 ℃ 时 c(H⁺) = c(OH⁻) = 1×10⁻⁷ mol/L、Kw = 1×10⁻¹⁴，升到 100 ℃ 时 Kw 约为 5.5×10⁻¹³，中性水的 pH 约 6.1 而不是 7——pH = 7 就是中性只在 25 ℃ 成立。加酸加碱抑制水的电离，加入能水解的盐则促进水的电离。
detailEn: Strong and weak electrolytes are separated by one test only, whether ionisation is complete; neither solubility nor conducting ability belongs in the definition. Barium sulfate and silver chloride barely dissolve, yet every particle that does enter solution is fully ionised, so they are strong electrolytes, while acetic acid, miscible with water in all proportions, is weak — the belief that soluble means strong and insoluble means weak is simply wrong. Conductivity tracks ion concentration and the charge each ion carries, so a very dilute strong acid can conduct less than concentrated acetic acid. Ionisation is an ordinary dynamic equilibrium with all five of its behaviours, and since it absorbs heat, warming pushes it further. Three influences must be kept apart: dilution with water promotes ionisation and raises the degree of ionisation, yet c(H⁺) still falls and the pH rises, because the volume grows faster than the extra ions produced; adding a substance that supplies one of the same ions, sodium acetate or hydrochloric acid into acetic acid, suppresses ionisation and drives the equilibrium back; and warming promotes it, increasing both Ka and Kw. Ka answers to temperature alone, and at a given temperature the larger Ka the stronger the acid. Polyprotic weak acids ionise step by step with the first step far ahead of the second — carbonic acid has Ka1 near 4.4×10⁻⁷ against Ka2 near 4.7×10⁻¹¹ — which is why hydrogen carbonate both ionises and hydrolyses and ends up basic through hydrolysis. Three experiments settle whether an acid is weak: compare the pH of equal concentrations of the same basicity, where acetic acid sits well above hydrochloric; treat equal volumes and concentrations with excess zinc, where the total hydrogen is the same but the slow acid keeps producing gas as its reserve ionises; or take two samples of equal pH and dilute each tenfold, where hydrochloric acid gains exactly one pH unit and acetic acid less than one. Water belongs in the same account: at 25 ℃ pure water holds c(H⁺) = c(OH⁻) = 1×10⁻⁷ mol/L with Kw = 1×10⁻¹⁴, while at 100 ℃ Kw climbs to about 5.5×10⁻¹³ and neutral water reads roughly pH 6.1, so the rule that pH 7 is neutral is a statement about 25 ℃ only. Acids and bases suppress the ionisation of water; a hydrolysing salt promotes it.

subs.name: 氢离子
subs.note: 电离出的阳离子，决定酸性。

oneLiner: 盐的离子结合水电离的 H⁺ 或 OH⁻，使溶液显酸性或碱性。
oneLinerEn: Salt ions take H⁺ or OH⁻ from water, making the solution acidic or basic.
detail: 水解的本质是盐电离出的离子夺走了水电离的 H⁺ 或 OH⁻，生成弱电解质，使水的电离平衡右移，溶液于是显出酸性或碱性。规律四句：有弱才水解、无弱不水解、谁强显谁性、越弱越水解。CH₃COONa 是强碱弱酸盐，CH₃COO⁻ 结合 H⁺ 使 c(OH⁻) 大于 c(H⁺) 而显碱性；NH₄Cl 是强酸弱碱盐显酸性；NaCl 不水解显中性；相同浓度下 Na₂CO₃ 比 CH₃COONa 碱性更强，因为对应的酸 HCO₃⁻ 更弱。水解吸热（它正是中和的逆过程），所以升温促进：热的纯碱溶液去油污更好、明矾在温水里更快形成胶体。两种离子相互促进时水解能进行到底，即双水解：Al³⁺ 与 HCO₃⁻、CO₃²⁻、S²⁻、AlO₂⁻ 相遇即彻底水解生成 Al(OH)₃ 沉淀与气体，泡沫灭火器靠的正是 Al₂(SO₄)₃ 与 NaHCO₃ 这一对，这也解释了 Al₂S₃ 无法在溶液里制取。配溶液时要加对应酸抑制水解：FeCl₃、SnCl₂ 溶液都必须加盐酸，否则出现浑浊。应用还有几处：TiCl₄ 加大量热水制 TiO₂（升温与稀释双重促进水解）、焊接时用 NH₄Cl 除去金属表面的氧化膜、明矾净水（Al³⁺ 水解生成的 Al(OH)₃ 胶体吸附悬浮物）。判断离子浓度大小要靠三个守恒：电荷守恒（阳离子带的正电荷总数等于阴离子的负电荷总数）、物料守恒（各元素总量之比等于化学式中的比例）、质子守恒（由前两式相减得到，例如 Na₂CO₃ 溶液中 c(OH⁻) = c(H⁺) + c(HCO₃⁻) + 2c(H₂CO₃)）。最后一个常考结论是蒸干盐溶液得到什么：AlCl₃、FeCl₃ 溶液蒸干得到氢氧化物甚至氧化物，因为水解产生的 HCl 挥发使平衡一路右移；Al₂(SO₄)₃ 蒸干仍得原盐，因为硫酸不挥发；而 NaHCO₃ 受热本身就分解，与水解无关。
detailEn: Hydrolysis is a salt's own ions stealing back the H⁺ or OH⁻ that water produces, locking them into a weak electrolyte and thereby pulling the ionisation of water to the right, which is how a neutral solution turns acidic or basic. The four-line rule states it compactly: only a salt with a weak partner hydrolyses, a salt of strong acid and strong base does not, the stronger partner dictates the pH, and the weaker the partner the deeper the hydrolysis. Sodium acetate, born of a strong base and a weak acid, is basic because acetate claims protons and leaves hydroxide behind; ammonium chloride, from a strong acid and a weak base, is acidic; sodium chloride does neither. At equal concentration sodium carbonate is more alkaline than sodium acetate, since its conjugate acid hydrogen carbonate is the weaker of the two. Hydrolysis absorbs heat, being the reverse of neutralisation, so warmth accelerates it: hot washing-soda solution cuts grease better and alum builds its colloid faster in warm water. When both ions promote each other the reaction can go to completion — aluminium with hydrogen carbonate, carbonate, sulfide or aluminate collapses into Al(OH)₃ precipitate plus gas, which is the working pair inside a foam fire extinguisher and the reason aluminium sulfide cannot be prepared from solution. Stock solutions of FeCl₃ or SnCl₂ must be acidified with hydrochloric acid or they turn cloudy. The same chemistry makes TiO₂ by dumping TiCl₄ into large amounts of hot water, lets ammonium chloride strip oxide films off metal before soldering, and lets alum clarify drinking water through the gelatinous hydroxide it forms. Ranking ion concentrations requires three conservations: charge balance, in which total positive charge equals total negative charge; mass balance, in which element ratios match the formula; and proton balance, obtained by subtracting one from the other, so that in sodium carbonate solution c(OH⁻) = c(H⁺) + c(HCO₃⁻) + 2c(H₂CO₃). One last prediction belongs here, namely what remains after evaporating a salt solution: AlCl₃ or FeCl₃ leave the hydroxide and even the oxide, because the hydrochloric acid of hydrolysis escapes and drags the equilibrium all the way along, whereas aluminium sulfate survives intact since sulfuric acid is non-volatile; sodium hydrogen carbonate, for its part, decomposes on heating regardless of any hydrolysis.

oneLiner: K 只随温度变，转化率随投料比变，两者常被当成一回事。
oneLinerEn: K answers to temperature alone; conversion answers to the feed ratio — do not conflate them.
detail: 「化学平衡状态」只回答到没到平衡，平衡常数 K 才回答反应走到了多远。对 aA + bB 可逆生成 cC + dD，K 等于生成物浓度幂之积除以反应物浓度幂之积，幂指数就是方程式的系数。三条书写纪律必须背：固体与纯液体不入式，所以碳酸钙分解的 K 只剩二氧化碳的浓度，氢气还原氧化铜的 K 里有水蒸气却没铜与氧化铜；水要看情形，溶液里大量存在的溶剂水不写，气相反应中生成的水要写（这与「弱电解质的电离平衡」里对水的处理并不矛盾，那里水的浓度已被归进常数）；K 与方程式的写法一一对应，系数翻倍则 K 取平方，逆反应的 K 是原反应的倒数，所以报出 K 就必须同时报出方程式。K 只随温度变化，浓度、压强、催化剂都不能改它——这一句比“平衡移动”更硬，也是判断条件改变后新平衡位置的根本依据。它的数值直观说明进行的程度：一般 K 大于 10⁵ 视为进行到底，小于 10⁻⁵ 则几乎不反应。判方向靠浓度商 Q，表达式与 K 完全一样，只是把平衡浓度换成任意时刻的浓度：Q 小于 K 未达平衡且正向进行，Q 等于 K 正在平衡，Q 大于 K 逆向退回——勒夏特列原理的定量版本就是这句话（见「勒夏特列原理」）。转化率是另一把尺：等于已转化的量除以起始投入量，它随投料比而变，所以“温度不变则 K 不变，而转化率可以大变”是正确说法，把两者混为一谈的话题目里的一半错误就出在这里。两条常考结论：增大某一反应物的浓度，会提高其他反应物的转化率而降低自己的转化率，工业上让空气或水蒸气过量正是拿便宜的那一方去换昂贵的那一方；恒温恒容下按计量比同倍数加大投料，对气体分子数减小的反应相当于加压，转化率反而上升，这又与等效平衡的判读连着（见「化学平衡图像与等效平衡」）。计算一律走三段式：起始、转化、平衡三行，转化量之比等于系数之比，平衡浓度代入 K（起手式见「化学反应速率」）。温度对 K 的作用由热效应定符号：放热反应升温 K 减小，吸热反应升温 K 增大，所以一张 K 随温度变化的表就能反推 ΔH 的正负，这是高考最常考的一张表。K 还能解释工业上的取舍：接触氧化在低温下 K 已经很大，却仍要加热并使用催化剂，因为 K 管平衡不管快慢；合成氨的 K 始终不大，只能靠高压并把氨不断液化移走，把一个“走不远”的反应推着往前走（见「化学平衡状态」里的工业条件）。
detailEn: Equilibrium state answers only whether the balance has been reached; the constant K answers how far the reaction has travelled. For aA + bB reversible to cC + dD, K is the product of the production concentrations raised to their coefficients, divided by the same expression for the reactants. Three drafting rules must be carried. Solids and pure liquids stay out of the fraction: for decomposing limestone K collapses to the carbon dioxide concentration alone, and for hydrogen over copper oxide water vapour appears while neither solid does. Water depends on context — omitted as the solvent of an aqueous system, included as vapour in a gas-phase one, which does not contradict its treatment under weak-electrolyte ionisation, where its concentration has already been folded into the constant. K belongs to one written equation: double the coefficients and K is squared, reverse the reaction and K is inverted, so quoting a value obliges you to quote the equation. Only temperature moves K — no change of concentration, pressure or catalyst can, a statement harder than any about shifting, and the real basis for locating the new balance. Its size reads the extent directly: above about 10⁵ the reaction is treated as complete, below 10⁻⁵ as barely happening. Direction comes from the reaction quotient Q, identical in form but computed at any instant: Q under K means the forward way is still open, Q equal to K is the balance, Q above K sends it back — the quantitative voice of Le Chatelier (see that entry). Conversion is a different yardstick: amount converted over amount charged, and because it depends on the feed ratio, 'K unchanged while conversion moves' is perfectly sound — conflating the two produces half the errors here. Two results are worth memorising. Raise the concentration of one reactant and the others convert better while it itself converts worse; industry floods in the cheap partner (air, steam) to recover the costly one. At constant temperature and volume, scaling all feeds by the same factor is a compression for reactions that lose gas molecules, so conversion rises — which ties straight into equivalent equilibria (see the graphs entry). Every calculation runs the three-line table: initial, changed, equilibrium, the changes in coefficient ratio, the equilibrium concentrations fed into K (the setup is under reaction rate). Temperature acts on K with the sign of the heat effect: for an exothermic reaction K falls as temperature climbs, for an endothermic one it rises, so a table of K against temperature hands back the sign of ΔH — the device exams reach for most. K also explains industrial compromise: contact oxidation already has a generous K when cold yet is heated and catalysed, because K governs the balance and never the speed; ammonia's K stays small, so the process leans on pressure and on liquefying the product away, pushing forward a reaction that will not go far of itself (see the industrial conditions under equilibrium state).

term: 沉淀溶解平衡与溶度积
oneLiner: 难溶不等于不溶，一条溶解平衡决定了沉淀的生成、溶解与转化。
oneLinerEn: Insoluble is not un-soluble: one equilibrium decides precipitation, redissolving and conversion.
detail: 难溶不等于不溶。20 ℃ 下氯化银的溶解度约 1.5×10⁻⁴ g，看似为零，水中却确有银离子与氯离子；当固体溶出去的速率与离子沉回来的速率相等，就建立了沉淀溶解平衡，它是与电离平衡、水解平衡并列的第三大水溶液平衡（见「弱电解质的电离平衡」与「盐类水解」）。它的平衡常数叫溶度积 Ksp：氯化银是两种离子浓度之积，氢氧化镁则是镁离子浓度乘以氢氧根浓度的平方——幂指数来自计量式，所以 Ksp 不能跳类型比大小，氯化银与铬酸银型不同，Ksp 小的溶解度未必小，必须先算回溶解度才能比（同类型才直接可比）。判断有没有沉淀靠离子积 Q 与 Ksp 相比：Q 大于 Ksp 析出沉淀直到相等，等于 Ksp 恰好饱和，小于 Ksp 不沉淀还会继续溶解。这一条判据撑起三类应用。生成：粗盐里除去钙、镁与硫酸根离子就靠把它们变成沉淀（除杂顺序与试剂过量见「分离与提纯的方法及仪器配套」），检验硫酸根用氯化钡正是因为硫酸钡的 Ksp 极小且不溶于稀硝酸（见「常见离子的检验」）。溶解：碳酸钙溶于盐酸（氢离子带走碳酸根使平衡右移）、氢氧化镁溶于氯化铵（铵根结合氢氧根）、氯化银溶于氨水（生成配离子把银离子拉走，见「配位化合物」）——三条都靠同一个动作：降低离子浓度，平衡就向溶解方向移动。转化是最有画面感的一组实验：向氯化银悬浊液加碘化钾变黄、再加硫化钠变黑，转化总是从 Ksp 大的往 Ksp 小的走，所以锅炉里的硫酸钙先用碳酸钠转成疏松的碳酸钙再酸洗，重晶石也要靠饱和碳酸钠反复处理才能转化。生活与工业里的延伸都靠同一条逻辑：含氟牙膏把牙釉质上的羟基磷灰石转成更难溶的氟磷灰石而更耐酸；溶洞里碳酸钙与含二氧化碳的水生成可溶的碳酸氢钙、水分蒸发又析出碳酸钙，钟乳石就是这样一送一收长出来的；误服碳酸钡会中毒而硫酸钡能安全做钡餐，因为胃酸能溶前者而完全动不了后者（拆与不拆的道理见「离子反应与离子方程式」）。最后是分级沉淀：浓度相同的氯、溴、碘三种离子混合液里逐滴加硝酸银，溶解度最小的碘化银先析出（黄），再是溴化银（浅黄），最后才是氯化银（白）——这既是 Ksp 差异分离离子的基本手法，也是误服氯化钡后要用硫酸钠或硫酸镁洗胃而非稀硫酸的理由（后者会局部生成不溶的硫酸钡而前者提供足量安全的硫酸根）。
detailEn: Insoluble does not mean un-soluble. At 20 °C silver chloride dissolves to barely 1.5×10⁻⁴ g per hundred grams of water, yet silver and chloride ions are genuinely present; when solid leaves the lattice at the same rate as ions fall back, a precipitation-dissolution equilibrium stands — the third great solution equilibrium beside ionisation and hydrolysis. Its constant is the solubility product Ksp: for AgCl the simple product of two ion concentrations, for magnesium hydroxide the magnesium concentration times the hydroxide concentration squared. The exponents come from the formula unit, which is why Ksp values cannot be compared across types: for AgCl and silver chromate the smaller Ksp need not mean the smaller solubility, and one must convert back before ranking — direct comparison only works within the same pattern. Whether a precipitate appears is decided by the ionic product Q against Ksp: above it, solid falls out until equality; at it, the solution is just saturated; below it, nothing precipitates and existing solid may still dissolve. That single test supports three uses. Formation: brine is purified by turning calcium, magnesium and sulfate into precipitates (order and excess reagents under separations), and barium chloride detects sulfate precisely because barium sulfate's Ksp is minute and nitric acid cannot touch it. Dissolution: calcium carbonate goes into hydrochloric acid because hydrogen ions remove carbonate, magnesium hydroxide into ammonium chloride because ammonium takes hydroxide, silver chloride into ammonia because the complex carries silver away — in every case lowering an ion concentration drags the equilibrium toward dissolving. Conversion is the most pictorial series: to a milky suspension of AgCl, potassium iodide turns the solid yellow and sodium sulfide then black, because conversion always runs from the larger Ksp toward the smaller; hence boiler scale of calcium sulfate is first converted to friable carbonate with sodium carbonate and then acid-washed, and barite needs repeated treatment with concentrated soda. Everyday and industrial extensions follow the same logic: fluoride toothpaste converts the hydroxyapatite of enamel to the less soluble fluorapatite, which resists acid; in a cave, calcium carbonate with carbon dioxide-rich water becomes soluble calcium hydrogen carbonate, and evaporation lays the carbonate back down, so stalactites grow by one such round trip; swallowing barium carbonate poisons while barium sulfate is safe as a meal, since gastric acid dissolves the first and cannot move the second (the split-or-not rule sits under ionic equations). Grade-by-grade precipitation closes the topic: to a solution holding equal chloride, bromide and iodide, added silver nitrate throws down the least soluble silver iodide first (yellow), then pale silver bromide, white silver chloride last — the basic means of separating ions by Ksp, and the reason barium poisoning is washed out with sodium sulfate solution rather than dilute sulfuric acid.

term: 化学平衡图像与等效平衡
oneLiner: 先拐先平数值大，同一反应不同的投料也能撞上完全相同的平衡。
oneLinerEn: The curve that bends first settles first — and different feedings can reach one and the same balance.
detail: 平衡题的最后一公里常常是读图，而读图只有一条总纲：先认清纵横轴与每条曲线代表谁，再找拐点与平台，最后用“定一议二”把温度与压强分开谈。第一类是速率—时间图，它靠瞬时跳变暴露条件的改变：增大反应物浓度，正速率立即上跳而逆速率从原值逐渐追上来；升温使两条曲线都上移，但吸热方向抬得更高，从哪边抬得多就能反推 ΔH 的正负；加催化剂两条等幅上跳、平衡点不变；恒温恒容充入惰性气体两条都不动（各组分浓度根本没变），而恒温恒压充惰气两条都下移（体积膨胀把浓度稀释了）。第二类是含量—时间图，口诀只有六个字：先拐先平数值大——同组曲线里先出现拐点的实验温度更高或压强更大，据此定下 T₁ 与 T₂、p₁ 与 p₂ 的高低，再看平衡时含量的走向，就同时定出了正反应是放热还是吸热、是气体分子数减少还是增多。第三类是把转化率或含量画在温度轴上的山峰形曲线，陷阱最深：峰前段还在向平衡走，升温只是加快到达，峰顶恰是平衡点，峰后段才是平衡被高温顶回去、转化率反降；把全段都归因于平衡移动就错了。等效平衡是这套图的理论底座：同一可逆反应，在恒温恒容或恒温恒压下，把投料按计量关系折算到同一边后若满足相应条件，达到的平衡就完全等效（各组分百分含量相同，只是浓度或体积可能等比缩放）。三种情形必须分开：恒温恒容且反应前后气体分子数不等时，折算后必须与参照投料完全相同才等效；恒温恒容且气体分子数相等时，折算后成比例即可等效；恒温恒压时，折算后成比例就等效，因为体积会跟着伸缩而浓度不变。据此，充 2 mol 氨与充 1 mol 氮加 3 mol 氢在恒温恒容下完全等效，是第一条常用结论；而在氢气与碘蒸气生成碘化氢这类分子数不变的反应里投料加倍，含量不变而压强翻倍——这类“含量不变而条件变了”的题，全靠把等效与等效后的量分开算。至于图像与判据共同的落点，仍是「化学平衡状态」的判断标志与「勒夏特列原理」的定性方向，图像只是把它们变成曲线；读不出来往往不是不会判移动方向，而是没看清轴上写的物理量。
detailEn: The last mile of an equilibrium problem is usually a graph, and reading one has a single charter: identify the axes and every curve, find the bend and the plateau, then vary one condition at a time. The first family plots rate against time and betrays every disturbance by an instant jump. Raise a reactant and the forward rate leaps while the reverse climbs from its old value to meet it. Heat shifts both curves upward but lifts the endothermic direction further, and which one is lifted more hands back the sign of ΔH. A catalyst lifts both equally and moves nothing. Adding inert gas at fixed volume leaves both untouched, since no concentration changed; at fixed pressure both drop, because expansion diluted everything. The second family plots content against time, and its mnemonic is six characters — the curve that bends first settles first, and its number is the larger one: among sibling curves the one reaching a plateau sooner belongs to the higher temperature or pressure, which fixes T₁ against T₂ and p₁ against p₂; the settled contents then reveal whether the forward reaction is exothermic and whether gas molecules are lost or gained. The third family draws conversion against temperature as a mountain, and hides the deepest trap: before the summit the system is still approaching equilibrium, heating merely speeds the arrival; the summit is the balance point; only after it does heat push the equilibrium back and cut conversion. Reading the whole ridge as a shift is the standard mistake. Equivalent equilibria are the theoretical floor under all of this. For one reversible reaction, at fixed temperature with fixed volume or with fixed pressure, feeds converted to the same side of the equation reach an identical balance — the same percentage composition — if the corresponding condition holds. Keep the three cases apart. Constant volume with an unequal count of gas molecules: equivalence demands identical converted amounts. Constant volume with equal counts: proportionality suffices. Constant pressure: proportionality always suffices, since volume stretches while concentrations stay put. Thus charging 2 mol of ammonia is exactly equivalent to 1 mol of nitrogen with 3 of hydrogen in a fixed-volume vessel — the first conclusion anyone uses; while doubling the feed in H₂ + I₂ ⇌ 2HI leaves every percentage untouched and doubles the pressure, and this family of questions — composition unchanged, conditions changed — is answered only by keeping equivalence and scaling distinct. Both fall, finally, on the same ground as the tests under equilibrium state and the qualitative direction under Le Chatelier: a graph is those rules drawn as curves, and a failed reading is rarely a failed shift judgement but a misread axis.
